messages:
lee: Heads up — apse1 is showing a cluster of tiny-gang Pending pods, looks correlated to warmnode slot reservations not clearing. saw it ~14:05 UTC.
sam: Confirmed, metrics show reserved_slots > used_slots on 3 warmnodes (w-n-12,w-n-13,w-n-14). Pending tiny-gang count jumped to ~22.
ana: Scheduler coalescer logs have repeated commit timeouts and a few attach failures:
``nMay 03 14:06:21 coalescer[pid]: commit timeout warmnode=w-n-12 lease=lk-9 err=kvcache.stale
May 03 14:06:22 coalescer[pid]: attach failed pod=tiny-gang-zz reason=conn-reset
```
lee: We recently lowered the lease commit timeout to 30s in the apse1 canary; wonder if network flakiness + cache TTL is causing churn.
ops-jen: I can cordon w-n-12 and restart the coalescer process; will that disrupt anything critical?
sam: It's low-risk window; restarting should free slots. do it and capture logs.
ops-jen: cordoning and draining w-n-12 now:
$ kubectl cordon w-n-12
$ kubectl drain w-n-12 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data
evicting tiny-gang-fff
restarting coalescer svc on w-n-12

ops-jen: restart done, observing slot metrics.
sre-bot: Alert INC-20230503-49 created: rule/pending_gang_rate triggered. severity: low.
ana: slots on w-n-12 dropped reserved->0 within 40s; pending tiny-gang count falling. looks like restart fixed immediate symptom.
lee: Postmortem items: revert 30s commit timeout in canary until we understand kvcache TTL behavior; add coalesce.commit.latency metric and an alert for p95 >25s; add runbook entry: if >10 pending-gang for >3m, cordon+restart coalescer on implicated warmnode.
sam: I'll file the PM and add telemetry graphs. Also put a short probe to detect kvcache.stale spikes.
ops-jen: Runbook updated and PR for probe wired to dashboards.
lee: Thanks — leaving thread open until the PM is merged.
